name: Kassel

routes.outcome: Official City of Kassel Geoportal page loaded and identifies the public Regionalstadtplan and municipal geodata services.
Current Regionalstadtplan Web App configuration loaded. It uses EPSG:25832 and the Kassel ArcGIS portal/geocoder; no parcel layer was asserted from the configuration.
Official Hessen cadastral authority page documents ALKIS and its parcel objects, including Flurstücke; owner data was not requested.
Official Hessen open-data catalogue identifies ALKIS WFS resources, including adv:AX_Flurstueck.
Anonymous WFS capabilities returned WFS HE ALKIS NAS-konform and adv:AX_Flurstueck; capability evidence was saved under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/4197/.
Schema returned flurstueckskennzeichen and position geometry. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested.
Bounded anonymous request returned three AX_Flurstueck GML polygons. They were transformed from EPSG:25832 to WGS84 GeoJSON and retained with only the native flurstueckskennzeichen as properties.id.
Server rejected application/json as an unknown output format; the same bounded request without that format returned GML successfully. No retry used unsafe fields or credentials.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Kassel Regionalstadtplan ArcGIS Web App item 86758ddc1d474f968c5cf9057f0ac8c7; configured map coordinate system EPSG:25832.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N) in source GML; retained sample is GeoJSON WGS84 longitude/latitude.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: flurstueckskennzeichen; three values retained as properties.id.
schemaAndCrs.sourceFieldMapping: adv:AX_Flurstueck.flurstueckskennzeichen -> GeoJSON properties.id; adv:AX_Flurstueck.position -> GeoJSON geometry.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: 200 m x 200 m EPSG:25832 bbox centered approximately on the exact WUP point

localCustodianAssessment: The City of Kassel Geoportal and municipal Vermessung und Geoinformation context are evidenced; Hessen HVBG/GDS is the state ALKIS service custodian. The returned parcel service is state-level but covers Kassel. This is source evidence, not runtime adapter admission.

qualification.reason: A public ALKIS parcel WFS and safe bounded identity+geometry response are evidenced, but adapter admission remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
The bounded bbox response is not a citywide coverage or completeness claim.
Only three full parcel polygons were retained; larger unchanged GML and request evidence remain under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/4197/.
Native field names and source mapping are documented here; raw source attribute sets were not retained.
No unsafe owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
TLS verification remained enabled; no certificate exception was used.
This packet does not claim source integration, licensing clearance, or runtime admission.
uncertainty: The bounded response proves public anonymous parcel identity and geometry for the tested extent, but citywide coverage, update cadence, licensing/redistribution conditions, and runtime adapter behavior remain unresolved.
